text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Sniff, sniff, sniff, sniff— Alright, zero 
traces of criminal activity.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, full of energy today too, I see. Wait, 
your face is looking scary again, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Chew some gum and relax. Look, remember 
that piece I handed you before we left the 
room?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...No biting right now, sir! I am 
currently on patrol!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, you should chew some. You 
know gum works "wonders" on furrowed 
brows, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That's still unacceptable. Chewing 
gum on duty sets a terrible example!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"It's better if it has a gentle feel to 
it. It makes it easier for people in 
trouble to ask for help, too."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Come on, make the face you make when 
chewing gum in your room! You're so cute 
when you're totally absorbed in it—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Shhhhh! B-Bubble-san! What if someone 
hears you, de arimasu?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If anyone sees my relaxed side, my dignity 
will truly hit rock bottom...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you never mention that outside! 
Understood!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got it. Let's save the gum as a 
treat for when we're done, then!
